originalTitle: Hercules Capital (HTGC) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: Here's Why
summary: Hercules Capital (HTGC) closed at $16.74 in the latest trading session, marking a -1.18% move from the prior day.
content:
In the latest trading session, Hercules Capital (HTGC) closed at $16.74, marking a -1.18% move from the previous day. This change lagged the S&P 500's 0.73% gain on the day. Elsewhere, the Dow gained 0.49%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq added 1.19%.

The specialty finance company's shares have seen a decrease of 4.4% over the last month, not keeping up with the Finance sector's loss of 4.15% and the S&P 500's gain of 0.55%.

Market participants will be closely following the financial results of Hercules Capital in its upcoming release. The company is expected to report EPS of $0.49, unchanged from the prior-year quarter. At the same time, our most recent consensus estimate is projecting a revenue of $142.2 million, reflecting a 2.98% rise from the equivalent quarter last year.

Regarding the entire year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates forecast earnings of $1.95 per share and revenue of $578.1 million, indicating changes of +2.09% and +8.56%, respectively, compared to the previous year.

Investors should also take note of any recent adjustments to analyst estimates for Hercules Capital. These recent revisions tend to reflect the evolving nature of short-term business trends. Consequently, upward revisions in estimates express analysts' positivity towards the business operations and its ability to generate profits.

Based on our research, we believe these estimate revisions are directly related to near-term stock moves. To take advantage of this, we've established the Zacks Rank, an exclusive model that considers these estimated changes and delivers an operational rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, ranging from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), possesses a remarkable history of outdoing, externally audited, with #1 stocks returning an average annual gain of +25% since 1988. Within the past 30 days, our consensus EPS projection remained stagnant. As of now, Hercules Capital holds a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

In terms of valuation, Hercules Capital is currently trading at a Forward P/E ratio of 8.69. This indicates a premium in contrast to its industry's Forward P/E of 7.49.

The Financial - SBIC & Commercial Industry industry is part of the Finance sector. This industry currently has a Zacks Industry Rank of 98, which puts it in the top 40% of all 250+ industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our individual industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseContent:
在最新的交易日中，Hercules Capital (HTGC)收于16.74美元，较前一交易日上涨-1.18%。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数当日 0.73% 的涨幅。其他方面，道指上涨 0.49%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨 1.19%。

这家专业金融公司的股价上个月下跌了 4.4%，未能跟上金融板块 4.15% 的跌幅和标准普尔 500 指数 0.55% 的涨幅。

市场参与者将密切关注 Hercules Capital 即将发布的财务业绩。该公司预计每股收益为 0.49 美元，与去年同期持平。与此同时，我们最近的共识预测收入为 1.422 亿美元，较去年同期增长 2.98%。

就全年而言，Zacks 一致预期每股收益为 1.95 美元，营收为 5.781 亿美元，与上一年相比分别变化 +2.09% 和 +8.56%。

投资者还应注意 Hercules Capital 分析师预测的近期调整。这些最近的修订往往反映了短期业务趋势不断变化的性质。因此，预估的上调表明了分析师对业务运营及其产生利润的能力的积极态度。

根据我们的研究，我们认为这些估计修正与近期股票走势直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们建立了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，考虑了这些估计的变化并提供了一个可操作的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统的范围从#1（强力买入）到#5（强力卖出），拥有卓越的超越历史，经过外部审计，自 1988 年以来，#1 股票的平均年涨幅为 +25%。在过去 30 天内，我们的共识 EPS 预测仍然停滞不前。截至目前，Hercules Capital 的 Zacks 排名为#3（持有）。

就估值而言，Hercules Capital 目前的远期市盈率为 8.69。与该行业 7.49 的远期市盈率相比，这表明存在溢价。

金融 - SBIC 和商业工业行业是金融行业的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 98，在所有 250 多个行业中排名前 40%。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量各个行业组中个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量各个行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
